name: American Community Survey 1-year estimates

measures.definition: Average travel time to work of workers who commute, in minutes (table B08013 over B08301).
Share of residents born in another country: a measure of how international the city is.
Share of journeys to work made by bus, tram, metro or train.
Sitting rent: the median monthly gross rent (contract rent plus utilities and fuels) of every renter-occupied one-bedroom home paying cash rent in the city, old and new tenancies (table B25031).

Sitting rent: the median monthly gross rent (rent plus utilities) of every renter-occupied three-bedroom home paying cash rent in the city (table B25031); not stored where the Census tops it out at $3,500 or more.
Share of people aged 25 to 64 with an associate's, bachelor's or graduate degree (table B15001), the US counterpart of ISCED 5 to 8.
Share of workers who commute (working from home left out) who walked or cycled to work (table B08301).

rights.edition: ACS 1-year estimates, summary-file tables, latest year published
rights.attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates

vetted.notes: Summary files need no key; the API now does.

caveats: Rents are gross (utilities included) and cover every tenancy, so they read lower than asking rents for a home on the market today.
